extension_name.description: The display name for the extension.

extension_description.message: Fills logins, passwords, and TOTP codes from KeePassXC into Safari. Developed by Markus Griesslehner.
extension_description.description: Description of what the extension does, shown in Safari's extension settings.

entries_heading.description: Heading above the list of matching entries.

button_associate.description: Button that starts the association with KeePassXC.

button_generate.description: Button that generates a new password.

button_totp.description: Button that copies the TOTP code.

error_host_app_not_running.message: The SafariKeePassXC app is not running. Please start it and keep it open.
error_host_app_not_running.description: Shown when the host app is not running.

error_keepassxc_not_reachable.message: KeePassXC is not reachable. Is KeePassXC running with browser integration enabled?
error_keepassxc_not_reachable.description: Shown when KeePassXC cannot be reached.

error_database_locked.message: The KeePassXC database is locked. Please unlock it.
error_database_locked.description: Shown when the database is locked.

error_not_associated.description: Shown when the extension is not associated with KeePassXC.

error_unknown.description: Placeholder when no error details are available.

entries_empty.description: Shown when no entries match the current page.

entry_fill_tooltip.description: Tooltip on an entry button that fills the login form.

fill_no_form.message: No login form found on this page.
fill_no_form.description: Shown when filling failed because no form was found.

status_associating.message: Connecting… (please confirm the dialog in KeePassXC)
status_associating.description: Shown while association is in progress.

status_not_associated.description: Shown when connected but not associated.

copied_to_clipboard.description: Appended after a value that was copied to the clipboard.

totp_no_website.message: No website in the active tab.
totp_no_website.description: Shown when the active tab is not a website.

totp_no_entry.message: No TOTP entry for this page.
totp_no_entry.description: Shown when no entry with TOTP matches the current page.

save_banner_new.message: Save the login “$LOGIN$” for this site in KeePassXC?
save_banner_new.description: Banner question when new credentials were submitted.

save_banner_update.message: Update the saved password for “$LOGIN$” in KeePassXC?
save_banner_update.description: Banner question when a known login used a new password.

save_banner_button_save.description: Banner button that stores the new entry.

save_banner_button_update.description: Banner button that updates the existing entry.

save_banner_dismiss.description: Banner button that discards the queued credentials.

save_group_label.description: Label of the dropdown choosing the target group for new entries.

save_group_default.description: Dropdown option for KeePassXC's default browser group.
